Éire 100 marks Ireland's 100th official speedcubing competition!

Join us at the Ormonde Hotel in Kilkenny, the beloved home of Cubing in Cill Chainnaigh for a memorable weekend of excitement and cubing fun while we celebrate this huge milestone.

Alongside the official events, we will be running a speedcubing themed table quiz on Saturday night along with other surprises throughout the weekend to mark the occasion.

https://speedcubingireland.com/

Add us on [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/speedcubingireland/) and [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/speedcubingireland/?hl=en)! Join our [Discord Server](https://discord.gg/yuKTC3Hn8W)!
